Q: Where should a shared application decide whether an operation is permitted?
spoken: Keep the authoritative authorization and business-state transition in a service boundary used by every caller. UI code and model prompts can guide interaction but cannot grant authority. Model and retrieval adapters should expose bounded capabilities without owning unrelated domain rules. Validate the caller and target again at the consequential read or write boundary.

Keep the authoritative authorization and business-state transition in a service boundary used by every caller. UI code and model prompts can guide interaction but cannot grant authority.
